第二天，足足忙了一上午。

最近来看病的人越来越多，十里八乡的都往这儿跑。有的是听亲戚说的，有的是听邻居说的，说卫生院来了个北京医疗队，有个年轻大夫手艺好，什么病都能看。早上门还没开，门口就站满了人，端着搪瓷缸子的、抱着孩子的、拄着拐杖的，排了一长溜。

中午吃完饭都没顾上休息，继续开始看病诊治。王建新刚送走一个老大娘，还没来得及喝口水，突然听见院子里传来女人的哭声，撕心裂肺的那种。

“救命啊——快救命啊——”

王建新扔下听诊器就跑出去了。

院子里，一个三十来岁的男人被抬在门板上，几个人七手八脚地抬着往诊室跑。王建新跑过去一看，心里咯噔一下——面色青紫，大汗淋漓，瞳孔缩得像针尖大小，口吐白沫，衣服上有股刺鼻的农药味。

“有机磷农药中毒。”王建新脑子里跳出这几个字。

家属哭着说：“他在地里打药时逆风，吸了好长时间。过一会就觉得头晕恶心，硬撑着走回来，半路上就不行了……”

王建新没等他说完，转身就喊：“快！抬进抢救室！刘晓东，阿托品！李建国，解磷定！赵医生，准备洗胃！”

抢救室里顿时忙开了。

阿托品静脉推注，解磷定肌注，同时清洗皮肤、洗胃。刘晓东负责阿托品的反复注射，每十五分钟推注三毫克，他蹲在病人身边，眼睛盯着手表，时间一到就推，一秒不差。李建国在旁边记录用药剂量和时间，一笔一划，不敢马虎。赵医生负责洗胃，粗大的胃管从鼻腔插进去，洗胃液进进出出，刚开始出来的液体混着农药的臭味，整个抢救室都是那股味道。周小梅和陈秀英负责护理，一个擦汗，一个换药，忙得脚不沾地。

王医生也跑了过来，王建新头都没抬：“王医生，你负责维持静脉通路和生命体征监测。两条静脉通道，一条不能停，一条备着。”

“是！”王医生蹲下来，开始找血管。

抢救过程中，患者两次出现心跳骤停。

第一次，心电监护上的波形突然变成了直线，刺耳的报警声在抢救室里响起。刘晓东的手抖了一下，王建新一把推开他，双手交叉按在病人胸口，开始心脉复苏。按压的频率、深度、回弹，每一个细节都精准到位。三十次按压，两次人工呼吸，节奏不紧不慢。

与此同时，他用神识探查——患者心肌细胞严重缺氧，乙酰胆碱在心脏急剧蓄积，导致心律失常。他用一丝灵力包裹住心脏，像一只温柔的手，维持着心脏的基本搏动。同时指挥抢救：“阿托品再推三毫克！快！”

不到两分钟，心跳恢复了。心电监护上的波形重新跳了起来，虽然还不稳定，但好歹是跳了。

大家刚松了口气，不到十分钟，第二次骤停来了，比第一次更凶。心电监护直接变成了一条直线，连个波折都没有。刘晓东的手都在抖，拿阿托品的时候差点把针管掉地上。

王建新接替了按压，双手压在病人胸口，一下，两下，三下。他将灵力注入患者心包，强行唤醒那些濒死的心肌细胞。灵力像一剂强心针，顺着血管流向心脏的每一个角落。病人的脸色从青紫慢慢变回苍白，又从苍白泛起一丝血色。

三分钟的按压后，心跳再次恢复。这一次，波形稳住了。

抢救持续了四个小时。从中午一直忙到太阳偏西，当患者的瞳孔从针尖大小慢慢放大到正常，当他的面色从青紫转回苍白再转回正常，当他说出第一句“我这是在哪”的时候，所有人都松了一口气。

大家互相对视一眼，都有一种激动的喜悦心情。刘晓东眼圈红了，李建国咧着嘴笑，周小梅和陈秀英抱在一起，赵医生摘下眼镜擦了一把汗。

通力合作，抢救回患者的生命。

晚上，宿舍里还在探讨着这次抢救的事。刘晓东说他从来没打过这么多阿托品，李建国说他记药量记到手抽筋，赵医生说他洗胃洗得胳膊都抬不起来了。大家你一句我一句，越说越兴奋，谁也不肯睡。

王建新听了一会儿，笑了笑，没参与讨论。他躺在床上，闭上眼睛，脑子里过了一遍今天的抢救。哪些地方做得好，哪些地方可以改进，他都记在心里。

等大家都睡着了，他照例点了他们的昏睡穴，进了空间。

空间里亮堂堂的，大毛它们五个围上来，摇着尾巴。小狐狸从沙发上跳下来，跑到他脚边蹭了蹭。王建新喂了它们，然后走到河边盘膝坐下，开始修炼。灵气在体内运转，丹田里的灵力池平静如镜。今天消耗了不少灵力，得补回来。

第二天，不到十点，卫生院又来了一个急症。

年轻患者，二十出头，捂着右下腹，弯着腰，脸都白了。高烧不退，右下腹痛，反跳痛明显，血象高——典型的急性阑尾炎，已经化脓了，再不手术随时可能穿孔。

王建新决定马上进行阑尾切除。

The next day, I was busy all morning.

Recently, more and more people have come to see the doctor, and people from all over the country come here.Some of them were told by relatives, and some were told by neighbors that a Beijing medical team came to the health center and that there was a young doctor who was very skilled and could treat all kinds of diseases.Even before the door opened in the morning, there were already people standing in front of the door. There was a long line of people carrying enamel jars, holding children, and using crutches.

He didn't bother to rest after lunch and continued to see a doctor.Wang Jianxin had just seen off an old lady, and before he had a chance to take a sip of water, he suddenly heard a woman's cry coming from the yard, heartbreaking.

"Help—hurry, help—"

Wang Jianxin threw down his stethoscope and ran out.

In the yard, a man in his thirties was carried on the door panel, and several people rushed to the consulting room carrying him.Wang Jianxin ran over and took a look, and his heart skipped a beat - his face was blue and purple, he was sweating profusely, his pupils shrank to the size of a pinhead, he was foaming at the mouth, and there was a pungent smell of pesticides on his clothes.

"Organophosphorus pesticide poisoning." These words popped into Wang Jianxin's mind.

The family members cried and said: "He was working against the wind when applying medicine in the field and he breathed for a long time. After a while, he felt dizzy and nauseated. He had to walk back, but he couldn't stand it halfway..."

Wang Jianxin turned around and shouted before he finished speaking: "Quick! Carry into the emergency room! Liu Xiaodong, atropine! Li Jianguo, pralidoxime! Doctor Zhao, prepare for gastric lavage!"

The emergency room was suddenly busy.

Atropine was injected intravenously, pralidoxime was injected intramuscularly, and the skin was washed and gastric lavage was performed.Liu Xiaodong was responsible for the repeated injection of atropine, injecting three milligrams every fifteen minutes. He squatted beside the patient, staring at his watch, and injected it as soon as the time was up, every second.Li Jianguo recorded the dosage and time of medication beside him, one stroke at a time, not daring to be careless.Dr. Zhao is responsible for gastric lavage. A thick gastric tube is inserted through the nasal cavity, and the gastric lavage fluid flows in and out. The liquid that comes out at first is mixed with the smell of pesticides, and the entire emergency room is filled with that smell.Zhou Xiaomei and Chen Xiuying were responsible for the care. One wiped the sweat and the other changed the dressing. They were so busy that their feet did not touch the floor.

Dr. Wang also ran over, and Wang Jianxin didn't even raise his head: "Dr. Wang, you are responsible for maintaining the intravenous access and monitoring vital signs. There are two intravenous accesses, one cannot be stopped, and the other is ready."

"Yes!" Dr. Wang squatted down and started looking for blood vessels.

During the rescue process, the patient suffered cardiac arrest twice.

For the first time, the waveform on the ECG monitor suddenly turned into a straight line, and a harsh alarm sounded in the emergency room.Liu Xiaodong's hands shook, and Wang Jianxin pushed him away, crossed his hands and pressed on the patient's chest, and started to resuscitate the patient's heart.The frequency, depth, and rebound of compressions are all precise.Thirty compressions and two artificial respirations, at a leisurely pace.

At the same time, he used his spiritual consciousness to detect - the patient's myocardial cells were severely hypoxic, and acetylcholine accumulated rapidly in the heart, causing arrhythmia.He wrapped his heart with a trace of spiritual power, like a gentle hand, maintaining the basic beating of the heart.At the same time, he directed the rescue: "Add another three milligrams of atropine! Hurry!"

Within two minutes, the heartbeat returned.The waveform on the ECG monitor started jumping again. Although it was still unstable, it was beating anyway.

Everyone just breathed a sigh of relief. In less than ten minutes, the second sudden stop came, more fierce than the first.The ECG monitoring became a straight line without any twists and turns.Liu Xiaodong's hands were shaking and he almost dropped the needle on the ground when he took the atropine.

Wang Jianxin took over the compression, pressing his hands on the patient's chest once, twice, and three times.He injected spiritual power into the patient's pericardium and forcibly awakened the dying heart muscle cells.Spiritual energy is like a shot in the arm, flowing along the blood vessels to every corner of the heart.The patient's face slowly changed from purple to pale, and then a trace of blood appeared from pale.

After three minutes of compressions, the heartbeat resumed.This time, the waveform stabilized.

The rescue operation lasted four hours.It was busy from noon until the sun turned west. When the patient's pupils slowly dilated from pinpoint size to normal, when his complexion turned from purple to pale and then back to normal, and when he said the first sentence "Where am I?", everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

Everyone looked at each other with excitement and joy.Liu Xiaodong's eyes were red, Li Jianguo grinned, Zhou Xiaomei and Chen Xiuying hugged each other, and Dr. Zhao took off his glasses and wiped his sweat.

Work together to save the patient's life.

At night, the rescue was still being discussed in the dormitory.Liu Xiaodong said that he had never taken so much atropine. Li Jianguo said that he kept track of the dosage until his hands cramped. Dr. Zhao said that he couldn't lift his arms after gastric lavage.Everyone said something to each other, and the more they talked, the more excited they became, and no one wanted to sleep.

Wang Jianxin listened for a while, smiled, and did not participate in the discussion.He lay on the bed, closed his eyes, and went through today's rescue in his mind.He kept in mind what he did well and what could be improved.

After everyone fell asleep, he clicked on their sleep points as usual and entered the space.

The space was bright, and Da Mao and the other five gathered around, wagging their tails.The little fox jumped down from the sofa, ran to his feet and rubbed them.Wang Jianxin fed them, then walked to the river and sat down cross-legged to start practicing.Spiritual energy circulates in the body, and the spiritual energy pool in the Dantian is as calm as a mirror.I used up a lot of spiritual energy today and I have to make up for it.

The next day, before ten o'clock, another emergency came to the health center.

The young patient, in his early twenties, was holding his right lower abdomen, bent over, and his face was pale.High fever that persists, pain in the right lower abdomen, obvious rebound pain, and high blood count - typical acute appendicitis, which has suppurated and may perforate at any time without surgery.

Wang Jianxin decided to perform an appendectomy immediately.
